title: Isocitrate Dehydrogenase Assay Protocol
author: Kimberly Chapman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfisjkee

steps.title: Prepare IDH Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL of IDH buffer and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Combine 200 μL 0.5 M potassium phosphate pH 7.4 (for 10 mM final), 20 μL 1 M MgCl2 (for 2 mM final), 100 μL 100 mM NADP (for 1 mM final), and 50 μL 1 M isocitrate (for 5 mM final).
Add water to reach a final volume of 10 mL.

steps.title: Prepare Mitochondrial Lysates
steps.instruction: Prepare mitochondrial lysates according to protocol, ensuring a concentration of 15-30 μg in 20 μL.

steps.title: Load Samples
steps.instruction: Load 20 μL of the mitochondrial lysate into a 96-well plate in triplicate.

steps.title: Configure Spectrophotometer
steps.instruction: Set the spectrophotometer to Kinetic mode with the following parameters: dual wavelength 340 and 380 nm, 30 reads, 30 sec interval, and a temperature of 30°C.

steps.title: Initiate Assay
steps.instruction: Add IDH buffer to the plate and start the measurement.

substeps.instruction: Use a multi-chamber pipetter to add 200 μL of IDH buffer to each well while the plate is sitting on the spectrometer holder.
Mix by pipetting in and out 2x.

steps.title: Calculate Activity
steps.instruction: Calculate the relative activity using the OD 340 values.
